json.overall_experience: The Director of Human Resources likely found HubSpot CRM to be a highly intuitive and generally effective tool for their recruiting and business development tasks. They appreciated its ease of use and ability to organize contact information and track progress. While the core functionality served their needs well, they may have encountered minor limitations or complexities when tailoring it precisely to specialized HR workflows.
